dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/1: I wasn't born here, you know. My family came all the way from %2$s.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/2: Folk here still call me the stranger. I grew up in %2$s, a long way from this place.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/3: Some nights I miss %2$s. It's a long road back.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/4: My grandmother crossed half the world from %2$s to settle here. I've never seen it myself.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/5: Back in %2$s we did things differently, %1$s. I'm still getting used to this place.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/1: We moved here from %2$s, just over the hills. Not so different, really.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/2: I grew up in %2$s, not far from here. I still visit my kin when I can.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/3: My folks are in %2$s, a few days' walk away. They think I'm mad for living here.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/4: Came over from %2$s a few winters back. The weather took some getting used to.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_scho: I raised this rock to study the stars without the smoke of the towns, %1$s. The spell to bring it down again... I'm still working on that part.
Twelve years of notes, all up here. If the island ever comes down, the books come down with it, so I stay.
The clouds pass right through the garden some mornings. Wonderful for my research, terrible for my laundry.
I came up for one night of stargazing. That was, oh, a good few winters ago now.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_retr: Kings kept asking me to curse their neighbours. Up here nobody asks me anything, %1$s. Present company excepted.
I served three courts before I'd had enough of them. The wind is better company than any king.
A mage needs quiet to think. There's nothing quieter than a rock floating in the sky.
If any kingdom sent you to fetch me back, tell them you couldn't find the way up.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_ward: The island stays up because I keep it up, %1$s. Each morning I renew the spell. Miss a day and down it goes.
My master held this island before me, and her master before her. One day someone will hold it after me.
There's a village under us. I'd rather they never found out what keeps this rock off their roofs.
I can't leave for long. The spell holding us up gets thin when I'm not here.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_exil: I was a court wizard once, %1$s. One spell went wrong in front of the king, and they sent me as far from the ground as they could.
The crown said never to set foot in the realm again. They never said anything about floating above it.
I still keep the robe. They took the title, but they couldn't take what I know.
Some nights I can see the castle lights from here. I don't miss the place. Mostly.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.tail_explai: So you're not a werewolf... you were just born that way? Well, %1$s, I suppose you've never bitten anyone. I'm sorry I ran.
A warrior's tail, from a people far away? I don't quite follow, %1$s, but you're a friend. It doesn't frighten me now.
Oh! I thought you were some sort of monster. Thank you for telling me, %1$s. Your secret's safe with me.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ember_hug_y: Careful, %1$s! I'm Emberborn, you'll burn yourself. Drink something for the fire first.
No, no, don't! My skin's hot as an ember. Are you alright, %1$s?
Oh, %1$s, I'm sorry! Nobody holds an Emberborn without fire in their own blood, or a potion against it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ember_hug_m: Ow! %1$s, you're burning hot! Keep your Emberborn arms to yourself!
Ah! My shirt's smoking! A wave would do, %1$s.
Hot! Hot! I'd hug you, %1$s, if you weren't on fire inside.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.tail_explai: That explains a great deal. I'll stop hiding behind the well whenever you pass, %1$s.
I am %s %s, and %3$s is mine to rule.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_refuse: My name is none of your business.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_outlaw: Names get people hanged. You'll not have mine.
Call me whatever you like. You won't be calling me anything for long.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_wary.0: My name's for folk I trust. You're not that. Not yet.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_wary.1: Remember where you are. This place isn't for you, and my name isn't either.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_wary.2: Keep your hand. We'll see what you are first.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_wary.3: I've heard about your sort. Show me different, then we'll talk names.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_wary.4: Folk here will tell me if you're worth knowing. Till then, no.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.wary_openin: *They keep their distance and watch your hands, saying nothing.*
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.outlaw_open: Keep your hands where I can see them.
You've got some nerve, walking up to me.
*They look you up and down, one hand on their belt.*
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_zfight: I am %s. That is all anyone here needs to call me.
They call me %s. It's the only name I've had for a long while.
%s! Everybody knows that. Well, everybody up here.
%s. You'll have heard of me. Or you will.
%s. Walk my road long enough and you will learn why.
%s. Remember it, in case you need to beg.
Call me %s. My real name wouldn't mean anything here.
%s. The sky had a name for me once. That one will do.
%s. Names don't matter at the anvil. Metal does.
%s. Say it quietly. Nobody else does.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_wrapp: You want to know what's under my belt, %1$s? A tail. Wound round and round, and it stays that way. One look at a full moon with it loose and they say I'd stop being me.
My mother made me swear, the night she showed me how to bind it: never let it out, not for anyone, not under any moon. I've kept that promise every day since.
Warrior blood, %1$s. The kind with a tail. Folk here would run screaming if they saw it, so it stays tied up under my shirt where it belongs.
On full-moon nights I bolt the shutters and don't look up. The tail's bound tight, but the old stories don't say how tight is tight enough.
I was ashamed of it as a child. Now I just keep it wrapped and keep quiet. Strangers don't need to know what my grandfather was.
Cut it off? I've thought about it. But it's part of me, %1$s. So I keep it hidden instead, and I keep indoors when the moon is round.
I don't remember the night it happened, %1$s. Only waking in a field, and everyone looking at me. The tail had come loose. It hasn't since.
There's a broken roof on the east side they still haven't fixed. That was me, they tell me, under the full moon. I bind it twice as tight now.
The moon took me once. Something huge, and red-eyed, and not me. I can't bring myself to cut the tail... but I'm afraid of every full moon.
They say I was taller than the church tower. I believe them. My knuckles were raw for a week and I've no memory of why.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/1: I was born with a tail, %1$s. My parents had it cut the night I was born, so I'd never turn under the moon. I've only the scar to show for it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/2: Lost it in a fight, years back. A blade meant for my neck took the tail instead. It never grew back, and honestly, I sleep better for it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/3: Warrior blood, they call it. I had the tail once. The village elder took it off with a woodsman's axe after... well. After there was a rampage. Nobody speaks of it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/4: My father cut his own off before I was born, and mine the day I could walk. He said our family had done enough damage under full moons.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/5: There's just a stump now, %1$s. Some of my kin's grows back, they say. Mine never has. I stopped waiting for it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/6: The healer who birthed me cut it off without asking anyone. My mother cried for a week. I'm glad she did it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut_r: I turned, %1$s. Under the full moon, the tail came loose and I became... that. Somebody brought me down and cut it off. It's never coming back, and I'm glad.
You've heard about the ape, haven't you? That was me. They cut the tail off me while I lay there in the mud, and I woke up small again.
I still dream of the moon that night. Whoever took my tail saved this whole village. If you know who it was, tell them I said thank you.
No more tail, no more moon-madness. It cost me a rampage and half the market square to learn I should have cut it long ago.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_stone: Stone in the blood, my grandmother said. I feel the hills under my feet when I walk. Slow, but steady.
My hands glitter purple in the dark sometimes, %1$s. Don't stare, it's only the stone in me.
My people were miners before there were names for them. I'd still rather sleep underground than under the sky.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_tideb: Tideborn, %1$s. I can hold my breath longer than you'd believe. The gills help.
My father came up out of the sea, or so my mother tells it. I've never quite felt dry since.
The marks on my arms glow when I'm wet. Fishermen think it's luck. I don't tell them otherwise.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_sylva: Sylvan blood. The fireflies follow me about. I've learned to stop shooing them.
The old forest folk were my ancestors. I fall soft and walk quiet, %1$s, but I'm no use in a fistfight.
See this vine on my arm? Born with it. It glows a little at night, like the woods remember me.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_verda: Yes, I'm green, %1$s. And yes, the antennae are real. My people come from very far away.
A sunny day fills me up better than bread. Fire, though... fire I stay well clear of.
My kind came from a green world, once. I've never seen it. Some nights I think I hear it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_ember: Emberborn. Fire doesn't touch me, %1$s. Winter, though, winter takes it out of me.
I once pulled a child out of a burning barn. Not a burn on me. The cold that night nearly killed me instead.
See the glow in my eyes? My mother had it too. Our blood runs hot.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_frost: Frostborn, %1$s. The cold never bites me. The heat, though, the heat I can't abide.
My grandmother kept a little box of her mother's things that hum when you touch them. Nobody here can say what they're for. I still sleep with the window open in midwinter.
Snow falls off my hands even in summer. Children think it's a trick. It isn't.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_night: Nightborn. I'm quicker after dark, %1$s. Midday leaves me feeling half-asleep.
My eyes shine silver by day. Folk find it unsettling. I find the sun unsettling, so we're even.
The stars are in my blood, my father said. I believe him on the darkest nights.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_storm: Stormborn, %1$s. When the thunder rolls in, I feel it in my teeth.
My grandmother was struck by lightning twice. She called it being kissed by the sky.
Don't ask me to go down the mine. I can't breathe without the sky over me.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_dawnb: Dawnborn. Give me a long summer day, %1$s, and I'll outwork anyone here.
The dead don't like us. They know the sun is on our side.
Nights are long for my kind. I count the hours till dawn.
Praise the sun, %1$s! Every morning it comes back for us.
Praise the sun! It has never once failed to come back.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_endbo: Endborn, %1$s. My mother came back from somewhere she never spoke of, and I was born after.
I keep a roof over my head when it rains. You'll understand if you ever see my skin after a storm.
The tall dark ones never mind me staring. I think they know what I am.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_drago: Dragonblood. Yes, %1$s, the scales are real. No, you may not touch them.
I sleep better with a bit of gold under the pillow. Don't laugh.
Fire's never scared me. My father used to warm his hands in the forge.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_deepb: Deepborn, %1$s. I can hear you breathing from the next room. Sorry, it's not polite.
Fireworks at the festival? I'll be in the cellar, thanks.
My people came up from the deep dark. Something down there still listens for us.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_earth: Earthling, %1$s. Nothing strange in my blood, but I learn fast. Show me something once and I've got it.
My family trained with the martial masters, generations back. I still wrap my hands out of habit.
Plain blood, quick hands. My grandfather said that's how our people kept up with the stranger ones.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_none: Power? I don't know what you think you saw.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_refuse: What I can do is none of your business.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_hidden: You saw that? It's %s. It woke in me one day. Please, don't tell my family.
Keep your voice down. Yes, it's %s. Hardly anyone knows, and I'd like it to stay that way.
I didn't think anyone was watching. It's %s. I use it as little as I can. Folk talk.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_open.0: %s! Impressive, isn't it? Let them stare, I don't care who knows.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_open.1: It's %s, and I'll use it however I like. Who's going to stop me?
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_open.2: You liked that? That's %s. I'm the only one round here who has it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_master: %s. I've worked at it for years, alone, where no one could see. You're not to speak of it.
Few would understand what I've made of %s. Fewer still should know. That includes you.
You saw what %s can be, in the right hands. Forget it, if you're wise.
%s. Others have it; none use it like I do. Watch and learn.
I didn't just wake to %s. I mastered it. Let the whole realm know.
%s answers to me as it answers to no one else. Remember that.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_corrup: %s... it isn't what it was. Something's wrong with it. With me.
Stay back. My %s has turned, and I can't always hold it.
It was %s once. Now it whispers. Don't ask me what it says.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_divin: Divine-born, %1$s. Don't mind the glow; it's a family habit.
My people keep the old hilltop shrines. We've never needed a lantern in them.
I eat twice what I look like I should. Light is thirsty work.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_biobu: Bio-built, %1$s. Yes, the seams are real, and no, it doesn't hurt.
My makers are long gone. I like to think I turned out better than the plan.
Thunder makes my teeth ache, %1$s. Something in the metal, they say.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_rubbe: Rubber-folk, %1$s! Go on, poke me. Everyone does.
Lost a finger once. It was back by the weekend, and so was my appetite for pie.
Keep me away from the campfire and the archers, and I'll be the best company you've had.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_gobli: Goblin, yeah. So what? Shiny thing on you, %1$s. Very shiny. Gimme?
Big folk say we ugly. We say big folk slow. Slow and stabbable.
King gets da gold, we get da rest. Mostly da rest is mushrooms.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_orc/1: Orc. Born in camp, die in fight. Good.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_orc/2: You wanna know bout tusks, %1$s? Come closer.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_orc/3: Every scar a story. Most end wit other one dead.
dialogue.main.jaymoskingdoms_q_swear: Swear you'll never raise a hand to me
dialogue.main.jaymoskingdoms_q_mood: What does your king think of me?
dialogue.main.jaymoskingdoms_tribe_mood: How does the tribe take to me?
dialogue.main.jaymoskingdoms_sworn_spy: Go back among your old tribe and listen.
dialogue.main.jaymoskingdoms_sworn_raid: Lead a raid on your old tribe.
dialogue.main.jaymoskingdoms_haven_vouch: Ask them to vouch for you at the gate
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.haven_vouch: Here. Show this at the gate of %1$s and they'll know you walk with me.
Take my token. The guards of %1$s know my mark. Don't make me sorry for it.
Vouch for you? I hardly know you yet.
My name's all I have here. I won't spend it on a stranger.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.tribe.tribu: %1$s, dis is straight. Straight is no good. Bend it on an anvil!
Straight ingot? Me no take dat. Bent only. Everybody knows.
Ha! You tink I am dumb? Dat is not bent, %1$s.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_beast: Beastfolk, %1$s. Yes, the ears are real. No, you may not pull them.
My kin keep to the wild lands. We would sooner hunt than haggle, but the rent still comes due.
There are many shapes of us: fur, feather, scale, and some with more eyes than is polite. We have heard every joke.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_hollo: Don't look so startled, %1$s. I got up again, that's all.
It's cold where I was. I keep my hands near the fire now, though I can't say I feel it much.
People cross the lane when I come by. I stopped minding. Mostly.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_haven_: %s. Yes, I'm one of yours, if that's what you're staring at. I married in. They stopped minding long before I did.
%s. Your towns had no room for me. This one did, so I stay where I'm let.
%s. They found me in a basket by the well. This is the only home I've known, whatever I look like next to them.
%s. I set bones and they let me live among them. A fair trade, most days.
%s. I owe this place more than I can pay. I'll be working it off a while yet.
%s. They hid me when the banners came looking. Don't go telling anyone you saw me here.
